seen.extent: Three volumes of letters, 1730-33, 1734-37, 1738-42; number of cipher letters or passages unknown (inventory says only 'some').

prior_art.edition: WebSearch 'Frederik Willem Torck brieven Reinhard van Reede Amerongen 1730 1742' and 'Huis Amerongen inventaris 3486 Torck cijferschrift': no edition of these letters; Nederlandse historische bronnen 9 (Godard Adriaan van Reede archive) is a different series; DBNL biography gives Torck as raad en rekenmeester of Gelderland and Van Reede's brother-in-law (Aalbers, JOUT 1982, names him as co-signer of the 1742 marriage contract).

2446.key_check: No key held or known for these letters. Catalogue 1945 (Duncan to Aylva 1730-31, French, number runs) has a key filed in Gelders Archief 0439 inv. 126 whose cover names include Torck as 'F:F:'; that key did not open the digit runs when spot-tested there. Torck appears as a person named in that circle, not as a correspondent using that key, so it is the same political milieu but not shown to be the same cipher family or key; untestable until the Amerongen leaves are seen.

No duplicate of inv. 3486-3488.
